# Authored simulation contracts
`plan.json` records a real OTP 2.7.0 GraphQL response over NammaMove independently authored GTFS and geographic-grid inputs (CC0-1.0 fixture content only). It contains no real transport schedules, streets, user locations or live observations. Generated by the routing fixture/build pipeline; manifest input hashes and actual graph artifact digest are recorded in Phase 03 evidence. It is a portable contract fixture; genuine OTP tests are separately marked `otp`. No other project source is relicensed by this fixture notice.
